formal_allocation: T4-01; candidate once, independent auditor once, no retries
preflight: One separate read-only cases.json mount/hash smoke is allowed before T4-01; it does not import or execute detector.py and is not a candidate run.
candidate_command_template: docker run --name <unique> --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,size=16m --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 64 --memory 256m --cpus 1 -v <bundle>/cases.json:/work/cases.json:ro -v <bundle>/detector.py:/work/detector.py:ro -v <bundle>/run_once.py:/work/run_once.py:ro -w /work --entrypoint python3 python:3.12-slim -B run_once.py
auditor_command_template: docker run --name <unique> --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,size=16m --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 64 --memory 256m --cpus 1 -v <bundle>/audit.py:/work/audit.py:ro -v <bundle>/candidate.json:/work/candidate.json:ro -w /work --entrypoint python3 python:3.12-slim -B audit.py candidate.json
decision: PASS only for exact agreement with the five literal oracle rows and successful independent audit; this is a synthetic structural test, not an empirical failure-detector or availability result.
